items.story:
Microsoft has released a new Windows 11 security update to fix issues affecting certain Dell PCs, which had been experiencing shutdowns and other reliability problems. The update, known as KB5121767, is an out-of-band release, meaning it is being made available outside of the regular monthly update schedule. This move is seen as a priority effort by the company to address the concerns of Dell users who have been impacted by these issues. According to reports, the problems were causing significant disruptions for users, prompting Microsoft to take swift action.

The company has a long history of working closely with hardware manufacturers like Dell to ensure that its software runs smoothly on their devices. This collaboration is critical in identifying and resolving issues like the ones that prompted the release of this update.

The KB5121767 update is specifically designed to address the shutdown issues that some Dell PC users have been experiencing, and it is available for immediate download. Microsoft has confirmed that the update will fix the problems, which were caused by a compatibility issue between Windows 11 and certain Dell hardware configurations. The company has also provided guidance on how users can install the update, which is available through the Windows Update service. Experts have welcomed the release of the update, noting that it demonstrates Microsoft's commitment to addressing user concerns and ensuring the stability of its operating system.

The reaction to the update has been positive, with many Dell PC users expressing relief that a fix is now available. The release of the update has also been seen as a testament to Microsoft's ability to respond quickly to emerging issues and work collaboratively with hardware manufacturers to resolve them. However, some users have raised questions about why the issues were not identified and addressed before the release of Windows 11, highlighting the need for ongoing testing and quality assurance. The update has also sparked discussions about the importance of regular software updates and the role that users can play in helping to identify and report issues.

The release of the KB5121767 update has implications that extend beyond the Dell PC user community, as it highlights the complexities of ensuring software compatibility and reliability in an increasingly diverse hardware ecosystem. As the use of Windows 11 continues to grow, Microsoft will need to remain vigilant in identifying and addressing emerging issues, working closely with hardware manufacturers and users to ensure that its operating system runs smoothly and securely. The company's ability to respond quickly and effectively to issues like the ones affecting Dell PCs will be critical in maintaining user trust and confidence in its products.

As the situation continues to evolve, users and stakeholders will be watching to see how Microsoft builds on this update to further enhance the reliability and security of Windows 11. The company is expected to continue working closely with hardware manufacturers to identify and address potential issues, and to provide regular updates and guidance to users. In the coming weeks and months, it will be important to monitor the effectiveness of the KB5121767 update and to assess the broader implications of this development for the Windows 11 ecosystem and the wider technology industry.

items.headline: Nintendo Maintains No Obligation to Pass Tariff Reimbursements Directly to American Customers
items.teaser: Nintendo has stated that it has no legal obligation to pass on refunds to consumers for tariffs paid on its products in the United States…
items.story:
Nintendo has stated that it has no legal obligation to pass on refunds to consumers for tariffs paid on its products in the United States. The company made this assertion in a recent court filing, as it seeks to dismiss a lawsuit brought by consumers who claim they are owed refunds for tariffs paid on Nintendo consoles and games. The lawsuit was filed in response to the tariffs imposed by the Trump administration on goods imported from China, which included Nintendo's products. The company's stance on the matter has sparked a heated debate among gamers and consumer advocacy groups.

The tariffs in question were imposed in 2018 as part of a broader trade dispute between the United States and China, and they have had a significant impact on the gaming industry. Many companies, including Nintendo, have been affected by the tariffs, which have driven up the cost of importing goods from China. The tariffs have been a major point of contention for gamers, who have seen the prices of consoles and games rise as a result. Nintendo's decision to absorb the cost of the tariffs rather than passing them on to consumers was initially seen as a positive move, but the company's refusal to refund consumers for the tariffs paid has sparked outrage.

According to court documents, Nintendo has argued that it has no legal duty to refund consumers for the tariffs paid, as the company has already absorbed the cost of the tariffs as part of its business expenses. The company has also stated that it has not made any promises or representations to consumers regarding tariff refunds. Nintendo's lawyers have filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit, citing a lack of merit and jurisdiction. The company's official statement on the matter has been concise, with a spokesperson stating that Nintendo's position on the matter is clear and consistent with its business practices.

The reaction to Nintendo's stance on tariff refunds has been largely negative, with many gamers and consumer advocacy groups expressing outrage and disappointment. Some consumers have taken to social media to voice their discontent, with many calling for a boycott of Nintendo products. The lawsuit against Nintendo has also sparked a wider debate about the impact of tariffs on consumers and the responsibility of companies to refund consumers for tariffs paid. Consumer advocacy groups have weighed in on the matter, stating that companies have a moral obligation to refund consumers for tariffs paid, even if there is no legal requirement to do so.

The dispute over tariff refunds is not unique to Nintendo, as other companies in the gaming industry have also been affected by the tariffs. The impact of the tariffs on the gaming industry has been significant, with many companies seeing increased costs and decreased profits as a result. The tariffs have also had a broader impact on the global economy, with many countries imposing retaliatory tariffs on US goods. The ongoing trade dispute between the United States and China has created uncertainty and instability in the global market, with many companies and consumers feeling the effects.

As the lawsuit against Nintendo moves forward, it remains to be seen how the court will rule on the matter. The outcome of the case could have significant implications for the gaming industry and beyond, as it could set a precedent for how companies handle tariff refunds in the future. Nintendo's decision to fight the lawsuit rather than refund consumers for the tariffs paid has sparked a heated debate, and the company's reputation among gamers and consumers may be affected by the outcome of the case. The matter is likely to continue to be closely watched by gamers, consumer advocacy groups, and the wider business community.

items.headline: Tech giant Anthropic secures major copyright resolution, yielding $1.5 billion in benefits
items.teaser: A US court has given final approval to a landmark $1.5 billion copyright settlement between Anthropic and a group of publishers, marking …
items.story:
A US court has given final approval to a landmark $1.5 billion copyright settlement between Anthropic and a group of publishers, marking a significant development in the ongoing debate over the use of copyrighted materials to train artificial intelligence models. The settlement, which was initially announced several months ago, brings an end to a high-profile lawsuit that had been closely watched by the tech and publishing industries. The case centered on allegations that Anthropic's AI model had been trained on copyrighted works without permission, highlighting the complex and often contentious issue of AI copyright infringement. This settlement is seen as a major step forward in addressing these concerns, but it does not provide a broader resolution to the issue.

The use of copyrighted materials to train AI models has become an increasingly contentious issue in recent years, with many publishers and authors expressing concerns that their work is being used without permission or compensation. The case against Anthropic was seen as a test of the boundaries of fair use and the extent to which AI developers can rely on copyrighted materials to train their models. The settlement approved by the court is one of the largest of its kind, and it is likely to have significant implications for the development of AI models in the future. This development marks a significant milestone in the company's efforts to expand its presence in the rapidly growing AI market. The launch of Helios is seen as a strategic move by AMD to challenge Nvidia's dominance in the AI hardware sector. According to industry observers, the introduction of Helios is expected to intensify competition in the market for AI systems.

The emergence of Helios is a culmination of AMD's ongoing efforts to develop and deploy AI-focused technologies, building on its existing portfolio of graphics processing units and high-performance computing solutions. The company has been investing heavily in research and development to enhance its AI capabilities, with a focus on creating scalable and efficient systems that can support a wide range of applications. As the demand for AI-powered solutions continues to rise, the launch of Helios is well-timed, enabling AMD to capitalize on the growing need for specialized hardware that can handle complex AI workloads. With its new rack system, AMD is poised to make significant inroads into the AI market, which is currently led by Nvidia.

Key details about Helios include its ability to support multiple AI frameworks and models, making it a versatile solution for a variety of applications, from natural language processing to computer vision. The system is designed to provide high-performance computing capabilities, while also ensuring energy efficiency and reliability. According to AMD, Helios has been optimized to work seamlessly with its existing hardware and software platforms, enabling customers to easily integrate the system into their existing infrastructure. Microsoft, as the newest buyer, will utilize Helios to support its own AI initiatives, further expanding the system's reach and adoption.

The launch of Helios has generated significant interest among industry stakeholders, with many viewing it as a major challenge to Nvidia's position in the AI market. Analysts believe that the entry of AMD into the rack AI system market will lead to increased competition, driving innovation and potentially lowering prices for customers. The fact that Microsoft, a major player in the technology sector, has chosen to adopt Helios is seen as a significant endorsement of AMD's technology. As the AI market continues to evolve, the introduction of Helios is expected to have a profound impact on the industry, with many companies reevaluating their AI strategies in light of the new system's capabilities.

The wider implications of Helios extend beyond the AI market, with potential applications in fields such as healthcare, finance, and education. As AI technologies become increasingly pervasive, the need for specialized hardware that can support complex workloads will continue to grow. The launch of Helios is part of a broader trend, with many companies investing in AI-focused initiatives and developing new technologies to support the growth of the AI ecosystem. With its new rack system, AMD is well-positioned to play a key role in this ecosystem, providing customers with a powerful tool for unlocking the potential of AI.

As the AI market continues to unfold, AMD's next steps will be closely watched by industry observers. The company is expected to continue investing in research and development, with a focus on enhancing the capabilities of Helios and expanding its portfolio of AI-focused solutions. With Microsoft on board as a customer, AMD will likely work closely with the technology giant to develop new applications and use cases for Helios, further driving adoption and growth. As the competition between AMD and Nvidia intensifies, the AI market is likely to become increasingly dynamic, with new innovations and developments emerging in the coming months and years.

items.headline: Iran's stance on US negotiations sparks oil market optimism with price adjustments downward.
items.teaser: Oil prices have fallen after Iranian officials indicated that talks with the United States could be pursued if they align with the countr…
items.story:
Oil prices have fallen after Iranian officials indicated that talks with the United States could be pursued if they align with the country's national interests, a significant development following nine consecutive nights of US bombing raids on Iran in response to repeated attacks on oil tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The potential for diplomatic engagement has eased concerns about further escalation in the region, which had driven up crude prices in recent days. The US has maintained that its military actions are aimed at deterring Iranian aggression and protecting international shipping lanes. Iranian leaders have vowed to defend their country's sovereignty and interests in the face of what they describe as unwarranted US aggression.

The current tensions between the US and Iran have their roots in a longstanding dispute over Iran's nuclear program and regional influence, which has been exacerbated by the US withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, or Iran nuclear deal, in 2018. The subsequent reimposition of US sanctions on Iran has had a devastating impact on the country's economy, leading to widespread hardship and unrest. The attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global oil exports, have raised fears about the vulnerability of the global energy supply and the potential for further conflict. The US has sought to build an international coalition to protect shipping in the region, but has faced resistance from some European allies who are wary of escalating tensions with Iran.

Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif has stated that his country is open to talks with the US, but only if they are based on mutual respect and a recognition of Iran's national interests. The US has indicated that it is willing to engage in diplomatic efforts to resolve the crisis, but has insisted that Iran must first take concrete steps to demonstrate its commitment to de-escalation. The price of Brent crude oil has fallen by over 2% in response to the potential for diplomatic engagement, as traders and investors weigh the prospects for a reduction in tensions in the region. The US has also announced plans to send additional troops to the Middle East to bolster its military presence in the region.

The potential for US-Iran talks has been welcomed by European leaders, who have urged both sides to engage in diplomatic efforts to resolve their differences peacefully. The European Union has sought to maintain its support for the Iran nuclear deal, despite the US withdrawal, and has called for a de-escalation of tensions in the region. The price of oil is likely to remain volatile in the coming days, as traders and investors respond to developments in the US-Iran crisis. The global economy is highly sensitive to disruptions in the energy market, and a prolonged conflict in the Middle East could have significant implications for economic growth and stability.

The US-Iran crisis has significant implications for regional and global security, and has raised concerns about the potential for a wider conflict in the Middle East. The US has sought to build a coalition of allies to support its efforts to deter Iranian aggression, but has faced resistance from some countries who are wary of being drawn into a conflict. The crisis has also highlighted the importance of diplomatic efforts to resolve international disputes peacefully, and has raised questions about the role of the US in the region. The international community is likely to be watching developments in the US-Iran crisis closely, as the potential for a diplomatic breakthrough or a further escalation in tensions remains high.

As the situation continues to unfold, attention will be focused on the prospects for US-Iran talks and the potential for a reduction in tensions in the region. The US and Iran have significant differences to overcome, and any diplomatic efforts will require careful negotiation and compromise. The global economy and energy markets will be closely watching developments in the crisis, as the potential for a disruption to the global energy supply remains high. The US and its allies will also be seeking to build a coalition of support for their efforts to deter Iranian aggression, as the international community seeks to promote stability and security in the region.

items.teaser: Civic body officials in Bengaluru were assaulted during an anti-encroachment drive, leading to the arrest of 10 individuals involved in t…
items.story:
Civic body officials in Bengaluru were assaulted during an anti-encroachment drive, leading to the arrest of 10 individuals involved in the incident. The incident occurred when the officials were attempting to remove illegal structures in the area. The authorities have stated that the drive was part of an ongoing effort to clear encroachments and improve infrastructure in the city. The assault on officials has raised concerns about the safety of those working to enforce the law and maintain public order.

The anti-encroachment drive is a longstanding initiative by the civic body to address the issue of illegal constructions and encroachments on public land. The city has struggled with the problem for years, with many residents and businesses occupying public spaces without permission. The civic body has been working to clear these encroachments and reclaim public land, but the process has been slow and often met with resistance from those affected. The latest incident highlights the challenges faced by authorities in enforcing the law and maintaining order in the city.

According to official reports, the 10 individuals arrested were involved in physically assaulting the civic body officials and attempting to prevent them from carrying out their duties. The officials were reportedly injured in the incident, but their condition is stable. The authorities have condemned the violence and stated that they will take strong action against those involved. The civic body has also announced that it will continue with the anti-encroachment drive, despite the challenges and resistance faced.

The incident has sparked reactions from various stakeholders, with many expressing concern about the safety of civic body officials and the need for stronger action against those who resort to violence. Residents and business owners in the area have also been affected by the anti-encroachment drive, with some losing their livelihoods or facing displacement. The incident has highlighted the need for a balanced approach that addresses the concerns of all stakeholders and ensures that the rule of law is upheld.

The incident in Bengaluru is part of a broader trend of resistance to anti-encroachment drives in many cities across the country. The issue of encroachments is a complex one, with many factors contributing to the problem, including poverty, lack of affordable housing, and inadequate urban planning. The authorities face a challenging task in addressing the issue, as they must balance the need to enforce the law with the need to protect the rights and livelihoods of those affected. The incident in Bengaluru highlights the need for a more nuanced and sustainable approach to addressing the issue of encroachments.

The civic body has announced that it will continue with the anti-encroachment drive, with increased security measures in place to protect officials and prevent further violence. The authorities have also stated that they will engage with stakeholders, including residents and business owners, to find a solution that addresses the concerns of all parties. The incident has raised questions about the effectiveness of the current approach to addressing encroachments and the need for a more comprehensive and sustainable solution to the problem. As the situation develops, it remains to be seen how the authorities will balance the need to enforce the law with the need to protect the rights and livelihoods of those affected.

items.headline: Andy Burnham assumes UK premiership, forming new cabinet amidst nationwide political upheaval.
items.teaser: Andy Burnham has become the seventh prime minister of the United Kingdom in a decade, taking office amidst a period of significant politi…
items.story:
Andy Burnham has become the seventh prime minister of the United Kingdom in a decade, taking office amidst a period of significant political turmoil in the country. He was sworn in as the new premier after a series of events that led to the departure of his predecessor, marking a new chapter in British politics. The handover of power occurred in a ceremony at Buckingham Palace, where Burnham accepted the role and its accompanying responsibilities. As the UK's new leader, Burnham faces numerous challenges, including addressing the nation's economic woes and navigating its complex relationships with international partners.

The UK has experienced a remarkable level of political instability over the past decade, with seven different prime ministers holding office during this time. This frequent turnover has raised concerns about the country's ability to maintain a stable and effective government, as well as its potential impact on the economy and global relations. The Labour Party, to which Burnham belongs, has a long history in British politics and has held power on several occasions, including under former prime ministers Tony Blair and Gordon Brown. Burnham's appointment is seen as an opportunity for the party to reassert its influence and shape the country's future.

Burnham's new cabinet features a mix of experienced Labour figures, with key appointments in finance, foreign affairs, defence, health, and other major portfolios. The finance minister is a seasoned politician with a background in economics, while the foreign affairs minister has extensive experience in international diplomacy. The defence minister is a former military officer, bringing a unique perspective to the role. These appointments are intended to provide stability and continuity, as the UK navigates its way through a complex and rapidly changing global landscape. Official statements from the prime minister's office have emphasized the importance of cooperation and collaboration in addressing the nation's challenges.

The reaction to Burnham's appointment and his new cabinet has been mixed, with some stakeholders expressing optimism about the potential for positive change and others voicing concerns about the lack of experience in certain key roles. The financial markets have responded cautiously, with the value of the pound fluctuating in response to the news. The public has also been watching developments closely, with many people eager to see how the new government will address the issues that matter most to them, such as the economy, healthcare, and education. As the new prime minister and his team begin their work, they will be under close scrutiny from the media, the opposition, and the general public.

The wider context of Burnham's appointment is closely tied to the ongoing debate about the UK's role in the world and its relationships with other countries. The nation's decision to leave the European Union, known as Brexit, has had a profound impact on its politics and economy, and the new government will need to navigate the complexities of this situation. Additionally, the UK is facing a range of global challenges, including climate change, terrorism, and economic inequality, which will require cooperation and collaboration with international partners. As the new prime minister, Burnham will need to balance the nation's interests with its responsibilities as a global citizen.

As Burnham and his cabinet begin their work, there are many open questions about what the future holds for the UK. The new government will need to make key decisions about the nation's economic policy, its relationships with other countries, and its approach to addressing the major challenges it faces. The opposition will be watching closely, ready to criticize any missteps and propose alternative solutions. The public will also be eager to see tangible results from the new government, and will be holding it accountable for its actions. As the UK embarks on this new chapter in its history, the world will be watching with interest to see how the country navigates its way through the complexities of the modern world.

items.story: വറുത്ത മീനിന് ഉപ്പില്ല; ഷെഫിനെ വെട്ടിപ്പരുക്കേൽപ്പിച്ച് ഹോട്ടലുടമ, കേസ് Manorama Onlineമീനിന് രുചി കുറവ്, അങ്കമാലിയിലെ ‘മീൻ വിലാസം’ ഹോട്ടലുടമ ഷെഫിനെ വെട്ടി Mathrubhumiമീന്‍ പൊരിച്ചതില്‍ ഉപ്പ് കുറഞ്ഞു; പാചകക്കാരനെ വെട്ടിപരുക്കേല്‍പ്പിച്ച് ഹോട്ടലുടമ Suprabhaathamമീൻ വറുത്തതിന് രുചിയില്ല; പാചകക്കാരന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വെട്ടി ഹോട്ടലുടമ manoramanews.comകറിക്ക് ഉപ്പില്ല: അങ്കമാലിയില്‍ ഹോട്ടല്‍ ജീവനക്കാരനെ വെട്ടി കട ഉടമ Siraj Daily

items.story: പാലാ നഗരസഭയിൽ കോൺഗ്രസ്‌ സഹകരണത്തോടെ എൽഡിഎഫ് അവിശ്വാസം പാസായി;രാജ്യത്തെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രായംകുറഞ്ഞ നഗരസഭാധ്യക്ഷ പുറത്തായി News18 Malayalamപാലായിൽ ദിയ പുറത്ത്; LDF അവിശ്വാസപ്രമേയം പാസായി, അനുകൂലിച്ച് കോൺഗ്രസ് അംഗങ്ങളും Mathrubhumiപാലാ നഗരസഭയിലെ അവിശ്വാസപ്രമേയം 21ന്; സ്വതന്ത്ര മുന്നണിയെ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുന്നതിൽ വിയോജിപ്പ് Manorama Onlineപാലായില്‍ യുഡിഎഫ് വീണു; എല്‍ഡിഎഫ് കൊണ്ടുവന്ന അവിശ്വാസപ്രമേയം പാസായി Media Oneപാലാ നഗരസഭയില്‍ യുഡിഎഫിന് അധികാരം നഷ്ടമായി; പ്രതിപക്ഷം കൊണ്ടുവന്ന അവിശ്വാസം പാസായി Twentyfournews.

Manorama Onlineമലയാളി വിദ്യാർഥിയുടെ കൊലപാതകം; സാവര്യയെ ക്രൂരമായി മർദിച്ചു, മരണം തലയ്ക്കേറ്റ ഗുരുതരപരിക്ക് Mathrubhumiസാവരിയയുടെ മരണം ,​ അന്യദേശത്ത് പൊലിഞ്ഞ സ്വപ്നങ്ങളും ഉത്തരം കിട്ടാത്ത ചോദ്യങ്ങളും Kerala Kaumudiസാവരിയയെ കാണാന്‍ രമേശ് ചെന്നിത്തല പോയില്ല, വിമാനത്താവളത്തില്‍ മൃതദേഹം വാങ്ങാന്‍ കോണ്‍ഗ്രസോ സിപിഎമ്മോ ഇല്ല, എന്തുകൊണ്ട്? Janmabhumiഉസ്ബക്കിസ്ഥാനിലെ മലയാളി വിദ്യാർത്ഥിനിയുടെ കൊലപാതകം;

items.story: സ്പാനിഷ് അർമാഡം! യൂറോ കപ്പ്, ഒളിംപിക്സ് സ്വർണം, ലോകകപ്പ്: എല്ലാം ഇനി ‘‘ടീം സ്പെയിനിന്റെ’ കയ്യിൽ ഭദ്രം Manorama Onlineമനം പോലെ! സ്പെയിനിന്റെ ലോകകപ്പ് വിജയം ആഘോഷമാക്കി പലസ്തീനി ജനത News18 Malayalam‘പൊരിഞ്ഞ പോരാട്ടം അല്ലാരുന്നു, ഗോളി മിടുക്കനായതിനാൽ 1 ഗോളിന് തോറ്റു’, സ്പെയിനിന് ആശംസയുമായി എംഎം മണി Asianet News Malayalamസ്‌പെയിനിന്റെ ഫെറാൻ ടോറസിന് ഒരു കൊച്ചി കണക്ഷനുണ്ട് Mathrubhumi‘സ്പെയിൻ്റെ ഗോളി ഇന്ന് പുറത്ത് ഇരുന്നാലും അവർ കപ്പ് എടുത്തേനെ’: MM മണി | MM Mani timeskerala.com

items.story: Researchers have uncovered a surprising culprit behind sleep loss in Alzheimer’s disease: the brain’s own immune cells. In mice with amyloid plaques, overactive microglia triggered inflammation that kept the brain from getting enough deep, restorative sleep. Temporarily removing most of these cells restored more than two hours of sleep per day, even though the plaques remained unchanged.

items.story: A quantum problem once described as impossible for classical computers has now been solved using relatively modest hardware. Researchers used tensor networks to compress the overwhelming wave function created by hundreds of entangled qubits, allowing some calculations to run on a laptop. Their results matched both theoretical predictions and simulations performed with a quantum computer. The method could open new paths for exploring quantum dynamics and materials.
